materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database materials were sufficient for owner-layer repair; supplementary PDF contains enzyme-property figures and no additional activity-value table.

summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review rebuilt 304 source-located activity rows from XML Tables 4-8, adjudicated 424 linked database rows, and preserved 9 database/source conflicts as cautions.
adjudication_summary: Primary XML tables support the activity rows and methods sections support assay conditions. Database mismatches remain explicit cautions; no open blocking/major rework target remains.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material extraction remains a separate upstream layer; this repair consumed its local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database outputs and did not rerun initial bootstrap.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural contract files are present; validator success alone was not used as acceptance evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/experiment rows are source_verified only when they match XML activity rows; DRAMP qualitative/structure/reference conflicts are preserved as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Tables 4-8 were parsed into row-level IC50/MIC records with raw units, target species/strain/cell-line context, conditions, and locators.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Unsupported host immune/membrane claims were removed; final mechanism claims are limited to source-supported SAR and 7-DMATS enzymatic production evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted_with_cautions only if strict semantic and publication gates pass with no open rework target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Some linked database rows remain source_conflict because their target/value/structure/reference details do not exactly match local primary evidence.
Local source supports activity/SAR and enzymatic production, not a direct antimicrobial killing mechanism assay.
